verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's site says in-product agents watch the product continuously, surface insights unprompted and recommend next steps [44]. It also claims to diagnose what changed as a working dashboard [15, 20], use AI to spot trends across replays and heatmaps [21], and give AI summaries of replay playlists [27]. Natural-language querying exists, but via the external MCP server rather than inside the product [19]. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the in-product AI insights/agents feature (all evidence is homepage marketing), independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights and suggestions work as claimed.
